title: All roles

help.title: About All roles
help.overview: Roles are permission packs assigned to company users. The default-for-signup setting also determines whether people appear under Company → Users or Company → Administration.

sections.title: Manage roles
items: Create a role, then edit its permission matrix to control what assigned users can access.
Roles marked as default for signup place their users in Company → Users. Roles without that setting place their users in Company → Administration.
Some built-in roles cannot be edited or deleted.

sections.title: Deletion and recovery
items: Deleting a role is a soft delete, so it can be restored later.
Review who uses a role before changing its permissions or deleting it.
